description:
Overview: Samsung 35W Power Adapter Duo (EP-TA220) is a compact wall charger with both USB-C and USB-A ports, designed to fast charge one or two compatible devices from a single socket. Performance & Capacity: When used with a single compatible device on the USB-C port, it can deliver up to 35W under Super Fast Charging 2.0 and PD 3.0 conditions, while the USB-A port supports up to 15W Adaptive Fast Charging for a wide range of phones and accessories.

Technology / Features: The dual-port layout lets you charge a phone and another device such as earbuds, a power bank or a second phone at the same time, with power intelligently shared between ports. Safety protections help guard against overcurrent, overheating and short circuits when used with supported devices and cables.

Ideal Usage Scenario: This adapter suits users who want to travel lighter or tidy their charging setup at home or at the office, especially if they use multiple USB-powered devices. It is suitable for many Galaxy smartphones, tablets and other USB-C or USB-A devices that support compatible fast charging standards.

Durability & Safety: The solid, travel-friendly form factor is intended for regular everyday use in indoor environments within the rated 100–240 V input range. For best results, pair it with genuine or good-quality USB-C and USB-A cables and follow device and charger safety guidelines.
